combo_label: Hair & Beauty × Perfume & Scent × Greek Mythology

entries.clue: Lion-skinned strongman of the twelve labours, under the Roman name Hollywood prefers
The trained nose who composes a fragrance from hundreds of raw materials.
Salon process of rods and waving lotion that leaves lasting curls
Virgin huntress of the golden bow, ranging moonlit wilds with her hounds
Bitter fruit of Calabria whose fragrant rind flavours Earl Grey tea.
Sliver of dead skin at the base of the nail, eased back with an orange stick
French for water, and the first word on countless fragrance labels.
Soft white mineral powder dusted over skin after a bath
Lovely youth rooted at a pool, wasting away for the face reflected there
Oaths on its waters bound even gods; the crossing cost a coin for the boatman
Dried flower bud of a tropical tree, warm and numbing on the tongue.
